name: codegen
description: codegen has no third-party runtime dependencies. This manifest exists so the repository configures through the vcpkg toolchain like Ghoul and SGCT, and so support/vcpkg/check-manifest-sync.cmake can verify that the overlay port under support/vcpkg/ports/codegen stays in sync with it. The only intentional difference is that the port depends on the vcpkg-cmake host tools explicitly.
